# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    s AS (
        SELECT
            employee_id,
            SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary) AS cur
        FROM Candidates
        WHERE experience = 'Senior'
    ),
    j AS (
        SELECT
            employee_id,
            IFNULL(
                SELECT
                    MAX(cur)
                FROM s
                WHERE cur <= 70000,
                0
            ) + SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY salary) AS cur
        FROM Candidates
        WHERE experience = 'Junior'
    )
SELECT
    employee_id
FROM s
WHERE cur <= 70000
UNION
SELECT
    employee_id
FROM j
WHERE cur <= 70000;
title: The Number of Seniors and Juniors to Join the Company II
